## Key claims (as stated in source)
- WAICO is an international organization focused on AI, **established July 2026**, proposed by China prior to the 2026 WAIC, **headquartered in Shanghai**, oriented toward the Global South.
- Viewed by analysts as a **rival to the US-led Pax Silica initiative**, aiming to counterbalance Western influence across rare-earth, semiconductor, and AI-governance supply chains.
- **History:** first proposed by Premier Li Qiang in July 2025; Xi reiterated at APEC (32nd meeting, October 2025). On **July 16, 2026, 29 countries signed** the agreement on the eve of WAIC. Guterres attended as invited guest. Wang Yi signed alongside Kazakh Deputy PM Jaslan Mädiev, Pakistani FM Ishaq Dar, Russian official Maxim Oreshkin, Indonesian Coordinating Minister Airlangga Hartarto.
- **Membership: 37 member states** — 29 founding signatories (July 16) + 8 later: Dominica (July 30); Brunei, Georgia, Iran, Sudan, Tanzania, Togo, Vietnam (July 31).
- Founding 29 listed: Algeria, Belarus, Brazil, Cambodia, Cameroon, China, Republic of the Congo, Cuba, Ethiopia, Indonesia, Kazakhstan (also Pax Silica member), Kenya, Kyrgyzstan, Laos, Lesotho, Malaysia, Mozambique, Myanmar, Nicaragua, Oman, Pakistan, Russia, Senegal, Serbia, South Africa, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, Venezuela, **Zambia**.
- **Observer:** Bangladesh (joined Aug 1, 2026).
- **Structure:** Council of Member States (highest decision-making authority) + Secretariat (one SG + two deputy SGs, 3-year terms) — per the founding treaty.
- Open-source emphasis: coincided with growing adoption of Chinese open-weight models (DeepSeek, Kimi, Z.ai), which "grew to account for around 40% of token usage among surveyed US firms by mid-2026" (citing CNBC, Kai Nicol-Schwarz, July 7, 2026 — i.e., source 83).
- **Reactions:** Carnegie's Arindrajit Basu (China may use WAICO to expand bilateral AI cooperation centers and shape UN AI policy); Nature's Elizabeth Gibney (2025: likely not enforceable governance, but technical cooperation/capacity-building); Indonesian analyst Heru Sutadi (WAICO must champion Global South interests).

## Verification notes
- Wikipedia is a **tertiary source** — treated as non-authoritative here; its WAICO facts trace to the primary/authoritative sources:
  - 29-country signing, date, Shanghai HQ, Wang Yi, Guterres → **source 113** (gov.cn/Xinhua, primary) and **source 112** (agreement text).
  - Governance structure (Council/Secretariat, 3-year terms) → **source 112** (agreement Arts. 5–8).
  - 37-member total and later acceders → Wikipedia cites "WAICO Signatories Reach 37" (Xiong, 2026-08-05) and IRNA/TPRA Sudan; not independently re-verified in this cache.
  - "40% of token usage among surveyed US firms" → **source 83** (CNBC).
- Note: Wikipedia's founding list includes **Zambia**, which is absent from The Diplomat's 29-country list (source 103); the two lists differ slightly (Diplomat omits Zambia). The gov.cn article (113) does not enumerate the full list.
